institute.about: EduRise Academy is a result-focused coaching institute helping students from Class 8 to Class 12 prepare for competitive exams and board examinations. Since 2014, our faculty-led, small-batch approach has combined rigorous academics with personal mentorship, so every student gets a clear study plan, regular feedback and the confidence to perform on exam day.
institute.mission: To make high-quality, honest exam preparation accessible to every serious student — with transparent fees, small batches and teachers who are accountable for results.

institute.vision: To be the most trusted coaching institute for families who value discipline, clarity and measurable progress.

policies.cancellation: Admission can be cancelled by written request (email or in person). Refunds, where applicable, are processed within 15 working days to the original payment method.
policies.refund: Full refund within 7 days of admission if no more than 2 classes have been attended. After that, a pro-rata refund applies for the first 30 days. No refund after 30 days, except in documented medical or relocation cases reviewed by the centre head.

scholarships.overview: Merit scholarships are awarded through the EduRise Scholarship & Level Test, held every month. Scholarships apply to tuition fees and are valid for the full program duration if the student maintains 75% attendance and the required test average.
rules: Score 90%+ in the scholarship test → 100% tuition scholarship
Board toppers (95%+) → flat 25% scholarship on any course
Sibling discount: 10% for the second child enrolled

study_material: Every course includes printed modules, NCERT-mapped notes, daily practice sheets and previous years' papers. Online students receive the same material as PDFs plus recorded class backups.
test_series: Weekly chapter tests, monthly full-length mocks and All-India test series are included in every competitive-exam course. Standalone test series (JEE/NEET/CUET) can also be purchased separately — contact our counsellor for pricing.
